ecoPrimals.role: THE BODY — the main organism, 19 primals, the genetic registry
ecoPrimals.anatomy: musculoskeletal + nervous + circulatory + digestive + immune + reproductive
ecoPrimals.note: The full organism. Every primal lives here.

protoKarya.role: THE GIFT — 'first cell', gifts given freely to the world
protoKarya.anatomy: reproductive — the organism's ability to GIVE LIFE to others
protoKarya.gift_philosophy: Take what was given. Give back MORE. The good Samaritan.
protoKarya.note: AMOEBA (RustDesk ZK fork) goes here. The simplest free-living organism.

sporeGarden.role: THE GARDEN — game engine, infrastructure, experiments
sporeGarden.note: esotericWebb lives here. The game engine. 28 capabilities. 484 tests.

amicusContra.role: THE SHIELD — 'friend of the court', civic defense, legal
amicusContra.anatomy: immune — the organism's legal immune system
amicusContra.note: Amicus curiae. Friend of the court. Defender.

defendDetroit.role: THE ARMOR — public record, Detroit defense
defendDetroit.note: The public record. The armor. Detroit.

syntheticChemistry.role: THE LAB — chemistry, springs, reagents, forges
syntheticChemistry.anatomy: metabolic — the chemistry that powers the organism
syntheticChemistry.note: The lab. The springs. Where chemistry becomes biology.
